A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TRUST-SCORE/TRUST-ALIGN study. Their complete main text, Appendices A–J, equations, tables and rendered figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original model evaluations on ASQA, QAMPARI, ELI5 and ExpertQA, alongside ablations and supplementary analyses.

after.justification: v4 retains original model evaluations on all four datasets, including the ablations and detailed appendix results.

M1.justification: The data-construction and DPO procedures are retained. Figure 2's reordered stages match the existing appendix workflow, while the added severity formula specifies a ranking score already used in v3.

E1.justification: Both versions use ASQA, QAMPARI and ELI5 for alignment and evaluation, and ExpertQA for out-of-domain evaluation. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including ICL, PostCite, PostAttr, Self-RAG, FRONT and the supplementary alignment and GPT-4-critic comparisons. Revised baseline descriptions clarify provenance.

E3.justification: Splits, sample counts, document context, prompts, metrics and training settings remain unchanged. The revised Self-RAG checkpoint description agrees with v3 Appendix H.3.4; notation edits do not change metric computation.

E4.justification: The data and refusal ablations, answerability case studies, prompting comparisons, hallucination analyses and data-size sensitivity study are retained. Figure 6's relocation adds no analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point-estimate reporting without repeated-run counts, random-seed information, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Corresponding tables and result plots retain their numerical values, rankings and findings, including Tables 2–7 and 19–22. Narrative terminology and percentage notation edits do not introduce new results.

T1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix E.5 add the explicit hallucination-severity definition e_q = sum_i e_i w_i, completing a missing mathematical specification in v3. The AC symbol changes in Equations 8–9 are notation corrections rather than altered mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions and conclusion retain the same metric, alignment and performance claims. Replacing 'exact match recall' with 'answer correctness' in the introduction aligns terminology with the existing results.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning parametric knowledge, refusal behavior and mixed answer-correctness performance are retained. Limitations involving claim decomposition, model capacity and augmented-data redundancy remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v4 explicitly supplies the severity-score aggregation used to select negative examples. Section 5 also specifies Hugging Face checkpoints for Self-RAG and training from provided instructions for FRONT, clarifying existing descriptions; other implementation and access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. The added introductory citation to Huang et al. (2024b) identifies the already cited FRONT baseline; the reference lists and Appendix C are retained.

P1.justification: Localized edits standardize answer-correctness terminology and notation, clarify baseline descriptions, identify Sparam inline and tidy prose. The overall narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is redrawn with reordered panels and more explicit descriptions of NLI labeling, document combinations, citation mapping and severity scoring. Figure 6 moves below the Appendix F.1 heading, with local spacing and pagination changes; table structures and other figure content are retained.

improvement.justification: v4 fills in the missing severity aggregation formula, makes AC notation consistent, and clarifies Figure 2 and baseline provenance. These provide limited improvements in specification, reproducibility and readability while leaving the empirical evidence and scientific conclusions unchanged.
